title: Koalafied Report
description: Structured report stored in Upstash Redis keyed by UUID with 30-day TTL. Designed for Supabase migration in V2. Two-phase construction: (1) Claude outputs match_level per category + all section narratives. (2) API route computes weighted_contribution, overall_score, tier, strong_count, ambiguous_count, gap_count and adds them before storing. Fields marked [Claude] are generated by the model. Fields marked [Computed] are added by the API route.

id.description: [API route] UUID v4. Generated before calling Claude. Stored as the Upstash key and embedded in the report URL.

schema_version.description: [API route] Schema version. Increment on breaking changes.

generated_at.description: [API route] ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the report was generated.

expires_at.description: [API route] ISO 8601 UTC timestamp 30 days after generated_at. Matches Upstash TTL.

role_title.description: [Claude] Job title extracted verbatim from the JD.

company_name.description: [Claude] Company name extracted from the JD. Null if not identifiable.

jd_level.description: [Claude] PM seniority level inferred from the JD. Used for level-calibrated scoring. Maps to taxonomy level_calibration keys.

quiz.description: [API route] User's quiz answers stored verbatim as enum strings. Passed into the system prompt so Claude can personalize the report. Mirrors Kit subscriber tags.

scoring.description: Formula: sum(category_weight × match_level_value) / 100. match_level values: strong=1.0, ambiguous=0.5, gap=0. Non-required categories default to ambiguous. Tier thresholds (preliminary — finalize during eval): strong_fit ≥70, borderline 50–69, not_ready <50. The 50 anchor is the all-ambiguous baseline; below 50 means gaps outweigh the no-evidence default.

overall_score.description: [Computed] Rounded integer. API route computes from category_scores after receiving Claude's match_level values.

tier.description: [Computed] API route derives from overall_score using threshold constants.

strong_count.description: [Computed] Number of jd_required=true categories scored strong.

ambiguous_count.description: [Computed] Number of jd_required=true categories scored ambiguous.

gap_count.description: [Computed] Number of jd_required=true categories scored gap.

category_scores.description: One entry per taxonomy category, all 9 every time. Non-required categories have jd_required=false and match_level forced to ambiguous.

category_id.description: [Claude] Category identifier. Must match taxonomy exactly.

jd_required.description: [Claude] True if the JD explicitly requires this category. False = baseline ambiguous applied, regardless of resume evidence.

match_level.description: [Claude] Claude's judgment on resume-to-JD alignment for this category. Non-required categories must be ambiguous.

weight.description: [API route] Category weight copied from the taxonomy before storing. Not output by Claude.

weighted_contribution.description: [Computed] weight × match_level_value (strong=1.0, ambiguous=0.5, gap=0). Computed by API route from Claude's match_level.

fit_summary.description: Section 01 — Overall read. Narrative feeds the hero area; top_strengths and top_gaps render as pills.

narrative.description: [Claude] 2–3 sentences. Direct and specific to this resume + JD pair. References concrete evidence. Not generic.

top_strengths.description: [Claude] Short labels for the 2–4 most significant strengths. Rendered as pills in the score hero.

top_gaps.description: [Claude] Short labels for the most significant gaps. Can be empty for a near-perfect match.

strengths.description: Section 02 — Strong category matches. One card per item.

explanation.description: [Claude] 2–3 sentences. References specific resume evidence. Explains why it's a strong match to this JD specifically — not generically.

ambiguous_areas.description: Section 03 — Skills present but underdemonstrated. Each item requires a concrete fix.

explanation.description: [Claude] 2–3 sentences on what's unclear or underdemonstrated. Be specific — 'can't tell if you're writing SQL or reading a dashboard someone else built' is better than 'insufficient evidence'.

fix.description: [Claude] 1–2 sentences of concrete resume advice. Start with '→ Fix:'. Include a specific example rewrite where possible.

gaps.description: Section 04 — JD-required skills not demonstrated in the resume. One card per item.

explanation.description: [Claude] 2–3 sentences. References the specific JD requirement that's unmet. Don't soften it.

severity.description: [Claude] minor: mentioned in JD but not a core requirement. moderate: explicitly called out, learnable quickly. significant: core JD requirement with zero resume evidence.

ai_assessment.description: Section 05 — AI skills cross-reference. Compares the JD's AI requirement against the candidate's self-reported level (quiz.ai_skill_level) and goals (quiz.ai_goal). Tiers are hierarchical: ai_product implies ai_tools. If required_tier is ai_product, the narrative covers both dimensions.

required_tier.description: [Claude] not_required: JD does not mention AI skills. ai_tools: JD wants tool fluency — using AI to do PM work faster (maps to ai_tool_fluency category). ai_product: JD wants AI product experience — managing/shipping AI features (maps to ai_product_expertise; implies ai_tools by definition).

required_tier_label.description: [Claude] Human-readable label for the callout box. e.g. 'AI Tool Fluency — Using AI to do PM work faster' or 'AI Product Expertise — Shipping AI features'

required_tier_description.description: [Claude] 1–2 sentences in plain English explaining what this tier means. Shown under the label in the callout box.

user_level_match.description: [Claude] Claude's judgment on whether quiz.ai_skill_level meets required_tier. not_applicable when required_tier is not_required.

gap_narrative.description: [Claude] 2–3 sentences comparing the candidate's stated level to the JD's requirement. References the specific quiz answer. Direct — does not soften a real gap. When required_tier is ai_product, addresses both tool fluency and product expertise dimensions.

specific_guidance.description: [Claude] 1–3 sentences of concrete, actionable guidance. Include a before/after example where possible.

learning_path.description: Section 06 — Prioritized learning items. Ordered by impact on this specific JD fit. Gaps addressed before ambiguous areas. Top 3–5 only — not exhaustive.

skill_label.description: [Claude] Human-readable label. e.g. 'SQL for Product Managers'

category_id.description: [Claude] Taxonomy category this item addresses. Null if cross-category.

description.description: [Claude] 2–3 sentences on why this is prioritized and what 'good enough' looks like for this specific JD.

resources.description: Section 07 — Learning resources. resource_key only — no URLs stored. Astro report page resolves keys to affiliate URLs via resources.js at render time. Claude only uses resource_keys from the approved list provided in the system prompt.

resource_key.description: [Claude] Must match a key in resources.js exactly. Never fabricated — Claude only selects from the approved list in the system prompt.

title.description: [Claude] Must match the title in resources.js exactly.

description.description: [Claude] 2–3 sentences on why this resource fits this candidate's specific gap — not a generic course description.

skill_label.description: [Claude] The gap this resource addresses. Used to group resources in the report. e.g. 'SQL / Data Fluency'

tags.description: [Claude] First tag must be 'Free' or 'Paid'. e.g. ['Free', 'SQL', 'Self-paced'] or ['Paid', 'Certificate', '6 weeks']

is_free.description: [Astro-resolved] Resolved from resources.js at render time based on resource_key. Not output by Claude.

projects.description: Section 08 — Concrete projects to build that demonstrate gap skills and become resume bullets.

title.description: [Claude] Action-oriented. e.g. 'Build a retention cohort analysis'

description.description: [Claude] 3–5 sentences: what to build, how to approach it, and why it demonstrates the skill credibly to a hiring manager.

difficulty.description: [Claude] Difficulty relative to a working PM with no prior experience in this skill.

demonstrates.description: [Claude] Short phrases for the 'Demonstrates:' line. e.g. ['Data fluency', 'Analytical thinking', 'PM communication style']

resume_recommendations.description: Section 09 — Specific resume fixes. At least one item must address a scored gap or ambiguous area. Before/after examples where resume evidence is available.

explanation.description: [Claude] 2–4 sentences explaining the recommendation and why it matters for this specific JD.

current_example.description: [Claude] Verbatim or paraphrased from the resume showing the problem. Null if no specific example is available.

improved_example.description: [Claude] Suggested rewrite. Null if current_example is null.

thirty_day_plan.description: Section 10 — Concrete 30-day action plan. Synthesizes learning path, projects, and resume recommendations into a sequenced week-by-week plan.

focus.description: [Claude] One-line theme. e.g. 'Fix the resume first'

actions.description: [Claude] Specific, completable actions. Concrete enough that the user knows exactly what to do.
